## 4.1 tally draws its own table {#extra-04.1}

A function `table` draws the header, the rule of dashes, and the rows, with the same widths as tabulate.

Apply the patch to [`src/tally/__init__.py`](#extra-04.1-src-tally-__init__.py-b5485b), from the top of the project:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/rahuldave/tally/commit/72b6c553d362423f55d6cf57aefbd53b5588beba.diff | git apply --include=src/tally/__init__.py
```

The patch removes `from tabulate import tabulate`, adds the function `table` above `main`, and calls it in place of
`tabulate`.

```bash
uv run tally --top 3 --table data/corpus.txt
```

It prints the same table as tabulate printed. It has the header `word` and `times`, a rule of dashes, and three
rows.

Check your files against this move. The command prints nothing when they match, and otherwise shows what differs:

```bash
git check 72b6c553d362
```

If you are stuck, this command puts the files of this move in place of yours. A file that you made yourself stays:

```bash
git restore --source 25f4f751628b --staged -- :/ && git restore --source 72b6c553d362 --staged --worktree -- :/
```

### What changed {#extra-04.1-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="extra-04.1-src-tally-__init__.py-b5485b"></a>`src/tally/__init__.py`: the function `table`, in place of tabulate. 10 lines added, 2 removed. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/tally/blob/72b6c553d362423f55d6cf57aefbd53b5588beba/src/tally/__init__.py).
  - look at `def table(rows: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> str:`

<details open><summary>The patch to <code>src/tally/__init__.py</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -2,7 +2,6 @@
 
 import sys
 
-from tabulate import tabulate
 from talib import top
 
 
@@ -14,6 +13,15 @@ def count(text: str) -> dict[str, int]:
     return counts
 
 
+def table(rows: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> str:
+    "The rows under a header and a rule: the words on the left, the counts on the right."
+    left = max([len("word") + 2, *(len(word) for word, _ in rows)])
+    right = max([len("times") + 2, *(len(str(times)) for _, times in rows)])
+    lines = [f"{'word':<{left}}  {'times':>{right}}", f"{'-' * left}  {'-' * right}"]
+    lines += [f"{word:<{left}}  {times:>{right}}" for word, times in rows]
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
 def main() -> None:
     "Count the words of a file, or of the standard input. Options: --top N, and --table."
     args = sys.argv[1:]
@@ -29,7 +37,7 @@ def main() -> None:
     counts = count(text)
     rows = top(counts, n) if n else sorted(counts.items())
     if as_table:
-        print(tabulate(rows, headers=["word", "times"]))
+        print(table(rows))
         return
     for word, times in rows:
         print(times, word)
```

</details>

## 4.2 tabulate goes {#extra-04.2}

Nothing imports tabulate now, but the project still depends on it. `uv remove` takes it out of `pyproject.toml`
and `uv.lock`:

The author ran `uv remove tabulate` here. It writes `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`. On a later day, it can write newer versions of packages than the author's, and this walk compares `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` exactly. So do not run it. Run this command in its place, from the top of the project. It takes each file as the author has it from the project, and installs exactly the versions that `uv.lock` names:

```bash
git restore --source 818eaf0e0f7c -- pyproject.toml uv.lock && uv sync --locked --all-groups --all-packages
```

```bash
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
```

All four tests pass, without tabulate.

Check your files against this move. The command prints nothing when they match, and otherwise shows what differs:

```bash
git check 818eaf0e0f7c
```

If you are stuck, this command puts the files of this move in place of yours. A file that you made yourself stays:

```bash
git restore --source 72b6c553d362 --staged -- :/ && git restore --source 818eaf0e0f7c --staged --worktree -- :/
```

### What changed {#extra-04.2-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="extra-04.2-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: tabulate is gone. 0 lines added, 1 removed. It comes from `uv remove tabulate`, and you take it from the project. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/tally/blob/818eaf0e0f7c19b85c5ff03b2ada94c58afbd299/pyproject.toml).
- <a id="extra-04.2-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: tabulate is gone. 1 line added, 14 removed. It comes from `uv remove tabulate`, and you take it from the project. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/tally/blob/818eaf0e0f7c19b85c5ff03b2ada94c58afbd299/uv.lock).
